title: Grant and revoke
lede: {{castAName}} is granted {{castPermSet}} with a duration and loses it again when the policy is deleted. Simulated; hosts are examples.

edges.label: Policy: Revoke pending, access still live

steps.title: Grant with a duration
steps.what: The admin grants {{castPermSet}} to {{castAName}} through a policy with a duration. Some sets are refused: one that needs a permission set license, one under another user licence, one the user already holds.

steps.title: The assignment is made in Salesforce
steps.what: Privilege signs in and assigns the permission set to the user. In Salesforce the user's Permission Set Assignments lists it.

steps.title: A receipt says Granted
steps.what: Access Receipts shows user, set, end date and status Granted, and the reconciliation line reads 1 confirmed.

steps.title: Delete the policy
steps.what: There is no Revoke button: the admin deletes the policy from its three-dot menu.

steps.title: Revoke pending, access still live
steps.what: The policy reads Revoke pending, access still live for a moment, and the assignment is still in Salesforce. The removal is queued; a refresh shows it.

steps.title: The assignment is removed
steps.what: The assignment is removed in Salesforce: reloading the user's Permission Set Assignments no longer lists the set. The policy count drops to 0 and Expired / Revoked shows 1.

steps.title: The receipt reads Expired / Revoked
steps.what: Access Receipts shows the policy under Expired / Revoked.
